SECTION C: Short Answer Type Questions (3 Marks Each)

Q25. Explain the implication of the ‘First World War’ on the economic and political situation 
of India.

Answer / Solution:
Explain the implication of the ‘First World War’ on the economic and political 
situation of India. 
Economic: Defense expenditure increased, financed by war loans and taxes 
(income tax introduced). Prices doubled between 1913-1918, causing hardship. 
Political: Forced recruitment in rural areas caused anger. The situation fostered the 
growth of the national movement and Satyagraha.
